fit_reason: This is a human-powered wood-and-canvas canoe; it has no gelcoat, machine-polishable paint, upholstery or trim of the kind we work on, and a traditional varnished wood and painted canvas boat calls for restoration specialists rather than a detailing service.
findings: Red painted canvas hull looks clean and evenly glossy in the full-length shot
Varnished cedar ribs, planking and gunwales look clean and well kept
Cane seats look intact with no visible staining
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the wood-canvas canoe, and it looks very well cared for, with a clean red hull and nicely kept varnished ribs and gunwales. Wood and canvas boats aren't something we detail, so we don't have a service to offer here. Good luck with the sale.
